functional_clarity.rationale: Core features work. Shortcode comment validation has regex bug. CLI and main workflow functional.

architecture_quality.rationale: Good module separation. No circular imports detected. Clear separation of concerns.

code_quality.rationale: 65 auto-fixable ruff violations. Many ruff ignores in pyproject.toml (tech debt). FutureWarning in L3.

operational_maturity.rationale: Health checks, orchestrator, graceful shutdown exist. Docker deployment. Some scripts untested.

test_confidence.rationale: 1448 tests pass but 25 fail (shortcode validator). Contract tests solid. No coverage reporting. Dev tools not in venv.

documentation_trustworthiness.rationale: README accurate for most features. Extensive docs. Minor staleness risk with 200+ scripts.

security_safety_confidence.rationale: No hardcoded secrets. API keys via env vars. Dry-run mode exists. Input validation present.

integration_fitness.rationale: Hugo build check in CI. Model loading tested. LMDB contract tests. Integration tests exist.

maintainability.rationale: Large script count (200+). Tech debt tracked in ruff ignores. CONTRIBUTING.md exists.

agentic_workflow_maturity.rationale: Autonomous workers exist. AGENTS.md guardrails. No explicit taskcard state machine. Basic health monitoring.

overall_adoption_confidence.rationale: CLI works. Dev deps not in venv. Setup requires manual steps. Docker path available.
